structured_output.summary: The change implements Object.prototype.isPrototypeOf faithfully. Step 1 returns false for non-object arguments via a let-else. Step 2 calls ops::to_object(this) with `?`. Step 3 loops, calling internal_get_prototype_of with `?`, returns false on null, and returns true when ops::same_value matches. Steps are in spec order, each has its spec-text comment above it, and errors propagate. The only other edit is renaming the unused `new_target` parameter to `_new_target`, which is confined to the in-scope file and needed once the `let _ = (...)` line is gone. The two failing test262 cases fail on the engine's own not-implemented error for Proxy [[GetPrototypeOf]], which is honest partial work.
structured_output.notes_for_next_attempt: No changes needed for this ticket. The remaining two test262 failures (arg-is-proxy.js) depend on Proxy [[GetPrototypeOf]] being implemented elsewhere, and that is out of scope for this ticket.
